ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اُوْحِیَ اِلَیَّ اَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوْۤا اِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْاٰنًا عَجَبًاۙ
ayahs.translation: Say, (O Prophet), it was revealed to me that a band of jinn attentively listened to (the recitation of the Qur'an) and then (went back to their people) and said:

ayahs.arabicText: یَّهْدِیْۤ اِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَاٰمَنَّا بِهٖ١ؕ وَ لَنْ نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَاۤ اَحَدًاۙ
ayahs.translation: “We have indeed heard a wonderful Qur'an which guides to the Right Way; so we have come to believe in it, and we will not associate aught with Our Lord in His Divinity”;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنَّهٗ تَعٰلٰى جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَّ لَا وَلَدًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and that “He – exalted be His Majesty – has not taken to Himself either a wife or a son”;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنَّهٗ كَانَ یَقُوْلُ سَفِیْهُنَا عَلَى اللّٰهِ شَطَطًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and that “the foolish among us have been wont to say outrageous things about Allah”;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنَّا ظَنَنَّاۤ اَنْ لَّنْ تَقُوْلَ الْاِنْسُ وَ الْجِنُّ عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and that “we had thought that men and jinn would never speak a lie about Allah”,

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنَّهٗ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ الْاِنْسِ یَعُوْذُوْنَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوْهُمْ رَهَقًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and that “some from among the humans used to seek protection of some among the jinn, and thus they increased the arrogance of the jinn”;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوْا كَمَا ظَنَنْتُمْ اَنْ لَّنْ یَّبْعَثَ اللّٰهُ اَحَدًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and that “they thought, even as you thought, that Allah would never raise anyone (as a Messenger)”;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِیْدًا وَّ شُهُبًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and that “we tried to pry (the secrets of) the heaven, but we found it full of terrible guards and shooting meteors”;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ١ؕ فَمَنْ یَّسْتَمِعِ الْاٰنَ یَجِدْ لَهٗ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and that “we would take up stations in the heaven to try to hear but anyone who now attempts to listen finds a shooting meteor in wait for him”;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنَّا لَا نَدْرِیْۤ اَشَرٌّ اُرِیْدَ بِمَنْ فِی الْاَرْضِ اَمْ اَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and that “we do not know whether evil is intended for those on the earth, or whether their Lord intends to direct them to the Right Way”;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنَّا مِنَّا الصّٰلِحُوْنَ وَ مِنَّا دُوْنَ ذٰلِكَ١ؕ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and that “some of us are upright and some of us are otherwise for we follow widely divergent paths”;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنَّا ظَنَنَّاۤ اَنْ لَّنْ نُّعْجِزَ اللّٰهَ فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ لَنْ نُّعْجِزَهٗ هَرَبًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and that “we thought that we will neither be able to frustrate Allah on earth, nor frustrate Him by flight”;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا الْهُدٰۤى اٰمَنَّا بِهٖ١ؕ فَمَنْ یُّؤْمِنْۢ بِرَبِّهٖ فَلَا یَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَّ لَا رَهَقًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and that “when we heard the teaching of the Right Way we came to believe in it; he who believes in His Lord shall have no fear of suffering loss or being subjected to any injustice”;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُوْنَ وَ مِنَّا الْقٰسِطُوْنَ١ؕ فَمَنْ اَسْلَمَ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا
ayahs.translation: and that “among us some are Muslims (Those who have submitted to Allah), and some of us are deviant. So those who became Muslims found the Right Course;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَمَّا الْقٰسِطُوْنَ فَكَانُوْا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًاۙ
ayahs.translation: but those who deviated from the Truth, will be the fuel for Hell.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنْ لَّوِ اسْتَقَامُوْا عَلَى الطَّرِیْقَةِ لَاَسْقَیْنٰهُمْ مَّآءً غَدَقًاۙ
ayahs.translation: If people were to keep firmly to the Right Way, We would have vouchsafed them abundant rain

ayahs.arabicText: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِیْهِ١ؕ وَ مَنْ یُّعْرِضْ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّهٖ یَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًاۙ
ayahs.translation: so that We might try them through this bounty. Whoso turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will cause him to suffer a grievous chastisement;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنَّ الْمَسٰجِدَ لِلّٰهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوْا مَعَ اللّٰهِ اَحَدًاۙ
ayahs.translation: and that “mosques belong to Allah, so do not invoke anyone with Him”;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ اَنَّهٗ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللّٰهِ یَدْعُوْهُ كَادُوْا یَكُوْنُوْنَ عَلَیْهِ لِبَدًا٢ؕ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: and when Allah's servant stood up to call on Him, they well-nigh swarmed him.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اِنَّمَاۤ اَدْعُوْا رَبِّیْ وَ لَاۤ اُشْرِكُ بِهٖۤ اَحَدًا
ayahs.translation: Say, (O Prophet): “I call on my Lord alone, and I do not associate aught with Him in His Divinity.”

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اِنِّیْ لَاۤ اَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَّ لَا رَشَدًا
ayahs.translation: Say: “Surely neither it is in my power to hurt you nor to bring you to the Right Way.”

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اِنِّیْ لَنْ یُّجِیْرَنِیْ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اَحَدٌ١ۙ۬ وَّ لَنْ اَجِدَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ مُلْتَحَدًاۙ
ayahs.translation: Say: “None can protect me from Allah, nor can I find a refuge apart from Him.

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا بَلٰغًا مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَ رِسٰلٰتِهٖ١ؕ وَ مَنْ یَّعْصِ اللّٰهَ وَ رَسُوْلَهٗ فَاِنَّ لَهٗ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِیْنَ فِیْهَاۤ اَبَدًاؕ
ayahs.translation: (My task is no more than) to deliver Allah's proclamation and His messages. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger, surely the Fire of Hell awaits him; therein he will abide in perpetuity.”

ayahs.arabicText: حَتّٰۤى اِذَا رَاَوْا مَا یُوْعَدُوْنَ فَسَیَعْلَمُوْنَ مَنْ اَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَّ اَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
ayahs.translation: (They shall not change their ways) until they see that against which they had been warned, and then they will know whose helpers are weaker and whose supporters are fewer in number.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اِنْ اَدْرِیْۤ اَقَرِیْبٌ مَّا تُوْعَدُوْنَ اَمْ یَجْعَلُ لَهٗ رَبِّیْۤ اَمَدًا
ayahs.translation: Say: “I know not whether what you are promised is near or whether my Lord will prolong its term.

ayahs.arabicText: عٰلِمُ الْغَیْبِ فَلَا یُظْهِرُ عَلٰى غَیْبِهٖۤ اَحَدًاۙ
ayahs.translation: He is the Knower of the Unseen, and He does not disclose His Unseen to anyone

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضٰى مِنْ رَّسُوْلٍ فَاِنَّهٗ یَسْلُكُ مِنْۢ بَیْنِ یَدَیْهِ وَ مِنْ خَلْفِهٖ رَصَدًاۙ
ayahs.translation: other than to a Messenger whom He chooses (for the bestowal of any part of the knowledge of the Unseen), whereafter He appoints guards who go before him and behind him,

ayahs.arabicText: لِّیَعْلَمَ اَنْ قَدْ اَبْلَغُوْا رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَ اَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَیْهِمْ وَ اَحْصٰى كُلَّ شَیْءٍ عَدَدًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: so that He may know that they have delivered the messages of their Lord. He encompasses in His knowledge their surroundings and keeps a count of all things.”
